name: trim-compaction
description: Compaction without a summary where possible: trims old tool outputs and stubs old edits, keeps every message word for word, and only falls back to Claude's summary (of the trimmed history) when that is not enough.

compactAtPercent.title: Compaction percentage
compactAtPercent.description: Context percentage at which a finished turn compacts.

targetPercent.title: Target percentage
targetPercent.description: If the trimmed history fits under this share of the context window, it replaces the history word for word; otherwise Claude's summary runs on the trimmed history.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Number of newest messages never touched.

minResultChars.title: Minimum output size
minResultChars.description: Tool outputs shorter than this many characters are left alone.

truncateHeadChars.title: Trimmed output head
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters of a trimmed tool output that stay.

stubEdits.title: Stub old edits
stubEdits.description: Replace the text of old Edit/Write calls with a note; the change is already in the file.

minInputChars.title: Minimum edit size
minInputChars.description: Edits shorter than this many characters are left alone.

protectedTools.title: Protected tools
protectedTools.description: Comma-separated tools whose output is never trimmed.

dryRun.title: Dry run
dryRun.description: Log what would happen, but always use Claude's summary on the untrimmed history.
